root_text:
Runny or stuffy nose
Cough
Fever (low-grade in most cases)
Wheezing
Difficulty breathing

In adults, symptoms of HMPV infection can be similar to those of the common cold and may include:

Runny or stuffy nose
Cough
Sore throat
Headache
Fev
